## What's new

- **Works next to other VPN apps.** RayLink no longer fails with "failed to listen TCP on 10808" when another app, such as v2rayN, is using the same local port. It picks a free port by itself. In proxy-only mode it tells you which port is taken, so you can choose another one in Settings.
- **Small phones and large text.** On Android, the Home screen fits smaller and lower-resolution phones, and labels are no longer cut off when the phone's text size is large.
- **Tray icon.** On Windows the tray icon is larger and sharp. On Linux the tray menu opens with a click.
- Fixes: on Windows, the window buttons no longer show yellow underlines; on Linux ARM devices, icons are no longer drawn as empty squares.
